def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    wages = 25000
    social_security_medicare_rate = 0.0765
    employer_and_employee_shares = 2
    futa_wage_base = 7000
    futa_rate = 0.06
    
    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    social_security_medicare_tax = (
        wages * social_security_medicare_rate * employer_and_employee_shares
    )
    federal_unemployment_tax = min(wages, futa_wage_base) * futa_rate
    total_tax = social_security_medicare_tax + federal_unemployment_tax
    
    # return answer
    return round(total_tax)
